analyst_response.spl_code:
search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-60m latest=now (action=failure OR action=success)
| stats
    count(eval(action="failure")) as fail_count
    count(eval(action="success")) as success_count
    values(src) as source_ips
    values(host) as hosts
    min(eval(if(action="failure", _time, null()))) as first_failure
    max(eval(if(action="success", _time, null()))) as last_success
    max(_time) as last_event
    by user
| where fail_count >= 5 AND success_count >= 1
| eval risk="P2 review - successful login after repeated failures"
| table user hosts source_ips fail_count success_count first_failure last_success last_event risk
| sort -fail_count
| head 100
